evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English.
Applicants with certificates issued abroad must apply for a VPD certificate from uni-assist via the HSBI application portal before applying.
The Abitur, Fachhochschulreife, an equivalent school-leaving certificate or an educational background that qualifies you for higher education is required.

notes: The tuition 'None' figure comes from the DAAD page's 'Tuition fees per semester' field for this programme; the programme is described as addressing students of all nationalities. The DAAD page gives the application deadline as 'until 15 July' without a year; the year 2027 is taken from the page header 'International Programmes 2026/2027'. The documents fact lists only the school-leaving certificate named on the DAAD page; additional documents (VPD certificate, recognised language certificate, cooperation agreement with a company, APS certificate for Chinese/Vietnamese/Indian certificates) are named only for work-integrated programmes generally on the HSBI page and are not listed here. Application to HSBI itself goes through HSBI's application portal, but foreign-certificate applicants must first obtain the uni-assist VPD, hence de-uni-assist-vpd. The language rule combines the DAAD requirement (English B2 with official certificate) and quotes IELTS/TOEFL as examples.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 72 Reading: 18 Listening: 17 Speaking: 20 Writing: 17

note.fr: Vérifiez votre admissibilité avec votre diplôme marocain dans la base de données anabin et via la VPD d'uni-assist.
note.en: Check your eligibility with your Moroccan diploma in the anabin database and via the uni-assist VPD.

evidence.quote: Additionally, the anabin online database also provides you with more details on the evaluation of foreign degrees.
